finite_data.requirement: All recorded numeric evidence is finite

sensor_evidence_channels.requirement: Capacity-aware trials record aligned foot velocity as well as measured force/position

configuration.requirement: Declared experiment, timing, finite force reserves and bounded movement checks

completed_recording.requirement: Recording ends through the experiment's declared controlled completion/stop path

future_loading_coverage.requirement: Known movement/stop phases determine future loading coverage; a logged flag cannot hide an interval

sample_clock.requirement: Continuous physics timestamps and aligned control/measurement intervals

mpc_update_cadence.requirement: Every periodic/support-change solve occurs; extra solves must install a changed force cap

solver_success.requirement: MPC NLP status is 0 or the existing controller's accepted status 2; every QP status is zero

strength_truth_boundary.requirement: Hidden pad capacity occurs only in evaluator metadata

physical_failure_model.requirement: Latched failure and subsequent deformation follow actual overload dwell, not commanded loading

probe_observed.requirement: A probe phase is physically recorded

probe_tripod_support.requirement: The original three legs remain measured supports throughout probe ramp, dwell, release and any probe-posture change

actual_dwell_certificate.requirement: Every capacity certificate is bounded by sustained actual achieved loading and measured-force reserve, with original three supports stable

certificate_changes_logged.requirement: A valid certificate has strictly positive tested capacity

future_declared.requirement: A future plan or conservative stop is reached

future_valid_certificate.requirement: Every future loading interval has a valid measured-evidence certificate

future_certificate_no_growth.requirement: Monitoring during continuous future execution may invalidate but cannot increase a capacity certificate

planned_force_with_reserve.requirement: Every planned/installed MPC load respects certificate minus declared tracking reserve

actual_future_loading.requirement: Actual future target loading stays below tested capacity throughout, independently of the MPC cap

body_stable.requirement: Measured roll and pitch stay within the declared stability limit

certificate_site_guard.requirement: A valid future certificate retains sensed contact within the declared uniform 10 mm horizontal / 2.5 mm vertical test region

meaningful_progress.requirement: Measured CoM advances >=30 mm while another foot is actually >=20 mm airborne for >=1 s, with three other measured supports

airborne_contact_schedule.requirement: A physically lifted foot is not still scheduled as a support

terminal_support.requirement: Every planned support remains physically loaded throughout the final half-second, with at least three stable supports

conservative_stop.requirement: An infeasible untested movement causes a sustained safe stop on the original three legs without claiming task completion

requested_force_is_not_achieved.requirement: At least 1 N of requested probe loading remains unachieved and cannot be certified

collapse_after_light_touch.requirement: Confirmed light contact is followed by actual weight-transfer overload and >=2 mm physical pad collapse; the unaware baseline intentionally has no capacity probe

configuration_v2.requirement: V2 declares one recognized strategy and the selected FL target

recovery_state_coverage.requirement: Recovery is one contiguous unload→lift→hold sequence through termination; a changed phase label cannot hide a support-loss interval

supported_sensor_configuration.requirement: Declared sensing uses bounded force noise, at most 0.2 mm componentwise position noise and zero delay

sensor_reserve_covers_declared_error.requirement: Measurement reserve covers the entire declared bounded force error

realized_sensor_error_bounds.requirement: Every recorded post-reset observation respects the declared bounded force/position errors and ideal contact channel

aligned_sensor_clock.requirement: V2 observations are synchronous with each control input; no unaccounted delayed samples

continuous_certificate_monitor.requirement: Every post-certificate tick checks contact/site validity, with irreversible invalidation until a fresh complete probe

certificate_evidence_sound.requirement: Any issued certificate has a complete independently verified physical evidence window, even if the trial later recovers

certificate_revision_finite.requirement: Certificate revision identifiers are nonnegative integers

probe_and_recovery_tripod.requirement: Original three supports remain measured and loaded through every probe and recovery transition

no_future_execution_after_failure.requirement: A failed pad never authorizes further weight-transfer movement

future_certified_or_unloaded.requirement: Every movement/stop interval respects certified actual and commanded loads, or leaves an uncertified target unloaded and unscheduled

recovery_commands_unloaded.requirement: Throughout recovery lift and hold the target is unscheduled, its installed force cap is zero, and its commanded support force is negligible

recovery_configuration.requirement: Recovery declares at least 20 mm lift, at least 2 s stable hold, and a bounded unload deadline

controlled_probe_failure_recovery.requirement: Failure occurs during a probe, followed by controlled FL unloading/lift and at least 2 s of terminal original-tripod support; no task completion claim

terminal_safe_stop.requirement: An intentional stop maintains the original tripod; any uncertified target is physically unloaded

conventions.passed: Only physical movement SUCCESS; expected collapse and SAFE_STOP are not task completion
conventions.expected_outcome_met: Protocol outcome validation, distinct from physical success
conventions.capacity: Sustained achieved minimum measured force minus measurement reserve; future caps also subtract tracking reserve
conventions.recovered_stop: A controlled recovery after actual probe failure; distinct from successful movement and from a pad that never failed
conventions.paired_comparison: Shared movement optimizer and constraints; only the permitted probing adaptation differs
conventions.probe_time: Recorded control intervals in probe_ramp, probe_hold, probe_release and reprobe_posture; recovery time is separate.
conventions.pad_damage: Actual simulator failure latch and displacement; never inferred from commanded foot force.
conventions.sufficient_test: The measured target retains the sensing/tracking reserves. The command additionally covers bounded sensing error and a declared empirical probe undershoot allowance; only the audited measured dwell certificate authorizes future loading.
conventions.task_capable: Avoidable damage is claimed only when the matched gentler-policy trial physically completes with an undamaged pad.
conventions.prior_failures: This sweep does not relabel the four earlier failures as preventable; their pads were below the task-required load.

probe_efficiency_identity.requirement: Probe dose changes while the frozen adaptive_probe controller and shared movement optimizer remain the foundation

probe_target_telemetry.requirement: Record minimum task load, sufficient test target, tolerance and selected probe target

reserve_and_sensor_configuration_consist.requirement: The frozen 1 N sensing and 8 N tracking reserves match public parameters, metadata and every control tick; command sensing allowance equals declared bounded sensor error

pad_displacement_channels_agree.requirement: Reported target-pad displacement equals the deformation trace audited by the unchanged physical failure validator

finite_probe_target_telemetry.requirement: All per-tick target telemetry has finite values and exactly matches the control clock

sufficient_target_preserves_reserves.requirement: Sufficient target equals the shared minimum future load plus unchanged sensing/tracking reserves and positive numerical tolerance

selected_target_matches_executed_command.requirement: Every additional test actually selects its recorded target amplitude; logging a gentler target while commanding more is invalid

selected_target_matches_planner_decision.requirement: Additional-probe index, minimum future load, request and selected amplitude match the logged planner decision

task_minimum_recomputed_from_geometry.requirement: The task load lower bound is recomputed from initial probing geometry and the unchanged shared movement constraints

probe_mpc_bounds_match_target.requirement: Additional-test MPC caps retain the frozen target + 0.2 N bound, and force commands obey the installed cap and declared solver tolerance

minimum_policy_targets_sufficient_load.requirement: Every additional minimum-policy probe declares its task-derived target

minimum_policy_does_not_select_maximum.requirement: The selected command is the measured sufficient target plus declared sensing error and probe undershoot allowance, not the achievable maximum
